business_problem: As part of the North American division of Robert Bosch GmbH, Bosch TTNA was new to smart device development and wanted a cost-effective solution to expand its infrastructure capacity and scalability while creating new smart technologies.
solution_summary: Customer Stories / Hi Tech, Electronics & Semiconductor 2023 # Bosch Thermotechnology Accelerates IoT Deployment Using AWS Serverless Computing and AWS IoT Core Bosch Thermotechnology North America developed its first cloud-connected device using AWS Lambda and AWS IoT Core, optimizing costs while improving customer experience. Overview Opportunity Solution Outcome AWS Services Used 4 months reduction in product time to market Reduced total cost of ownership (TCO) operational overhead Increased development team’s agility First-ever smart product released by Bosch Bosch Thermotechnology North America (Bosch TTNA) built a smart source of heating, ventilating, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems by modernizing and migrating its business to the cloud to monitor products remotely while removing the undifferentiated heavy lifting of managing the infrastructure.

solution_components.name: AWS IoT Core
solution_components.role: Connects IoT devices securely to cloud ingestion and device-management services.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Runs event-driven application logic without provisioning servers.

data_flow: The solution uses AWS serverless technologies for data processing, application integration, and the scaling required to manage its business.
